changes: PurposeEvidence separates useful realization, actual-pair comparison, qualified reply evidence, and stronger independent reply ownership. The same receipts rank both candidate families.

Functional contacts alone no longer complete a root purpose. An incidental guard route cannot outrank a realized beneficiary. Actual evaluated paths take precedence over a different surveyed idea when both have evidence.

One realized reply and another bounded failure can explain a conditional purpose. Re2 retains the negative Rae1/Nxc6 test and selects independent Nd5 realization instead of repeating Bb5 non-realization.
A shield accepted by capture closes its local exchange; Qa4 no longer borrows distant Qf5 merely to fill a missing purpose. Continuing pawn function remains after its original pawn is exchanged.

Scheduler and delivery share enriched actual-pair reading. An exhausted bounded inquiry may finish with an explicitly incomplete explanation. Kh1 keeps the actual Qe2 comparison rather than opening a redundant Nd4 root.

limitations: These saved-report checks do not establish fresh-screen generalization.
